app.name: WiiFlow WFL
app.long_description:
WiiFlow is a app for loading backup games from a USB Device or SD card.
It displays your games in a coverflow with 3D full box covers.
Key features: - Use of Simplified Chinese as the UI language - Emulated NAND support - Plugin system for emu apps - Devolution support - Nintendont support - Neek2o support
